output.summary: The run is VALID but the overall policy verdict is NO_POLICY with analysis coverage INCOMPLETE (reasons: CAPACITY_GUARD_FAILED, CAPACITY_STAGE_NOT_VERIFIED). Capacity analysis is INDETERMINATE: capacity_knee is null (knee_reason KNEE_DETECTOR_NOT_IMPLEMENTED), and no lower_inclusive/upper_exclusive or verified_bound_load is set. The single stage d16-cpu-limited-20users reports 20 users over 30 complete bins at target 20 with tolerance 0.1, but the capacity guard failed because the JMeter generator's cfs_throttled_period_ratio violated its 0.2 threshold (series mean 0.861, median 1, max 1; a finding reports 27 cells with observed values 0.3958–1.0). Because the generator was CPU-throttled, delivered load may not represent a clean 20-user workload, so the stage is INDETERMINATE and no capacity bound can be asserted. Business-side evidence shows zero errors (0/47396 overall; window policy PASS 0/38842) and latencies p50 4–199 ms, p99 306–806 ms, max 1018–1299 ms across transactions; these do not prove spare capacity, and temporal interpretation is blocked because clock alignment is not verified by core.

hypotheses.observation: The generator CPU throttle ratio policy check failed: rule generator-cpu-throttle-ratio (operator gt, threshold 0.2) returned status FAIL, the series shows mean 0.861, median 1, q25 0.955, max 1 over 30 cells, and a finding reports 27 cells with observed values between 0.3958 and 1.0 across 1790627160000–1790627430000.
hypotheses.possible_explanation: The JMeter generator may have been CPU-throttled through most of the window, possibly because its CPU quota was insufficient for the load it had to produce; throttled request pacing might mean the delivered load did not match the intended 20-user workload, which is consistent with the capacity guard failing (CAPACITY_GUARD_FAILED) and the stage being marked INDETERMINATE.
hypotheses.recommended_check: Inspect the generator's container/cgroup CPU quota and scheduler stats; re-run the stage with CPU headroom such that cfs_throttled_period_ratio stays at or below 0.2 in every cell before accepting any capacity conclusions.
